goal: Persist the source canvas snapshot on local chat messages, render low-noise source navigation, and prove that local canvas anchor metadata never enters sync or backup payloads.
non_goals: Do not implement Task 11 generation transactions, Task 12 HUD replacement, or later AI and retrieval work.
Do not migrate canvas context into remote sync state or accept remote canvasContext values.
Do not change canvas geometry, media ingestion, credentials, recovery or release behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Local chat rows tolerate nullable canvasContext and completionState migrations without deleting or reordering old chats.
The user message and its placeholder or system reply share one source-canvas snapshot captured before asynchronous work.
Invalid or historical context parses safely and source chips navigate existing canvases while missing sources remain non-blocking.
serializeChatForSync and all upload, backup and restore flows omit local canvas IDs, titles and node IDs while preserving ordinary content and completionState.
Remote restore cannot overwrite locally captured canvasContext on an existing message.
Focused tests, TypeScript, production build and diff checks pass.
Implementation is committed and independently reviewed.
notes: Read the Task 10 brief first and use test-first implementation.
Preserve message ordering and all existing chat content.
Canvas context is local-only and must be omitted structurally rather than redacted after serialization.
Use fixed UTF-8 I/O for non-ASCII reads and edits.
Never inspect, print, log or modify configured provider secrets.
